Fire incidents injure seven across two locations

Two separate fire incidents have resulted in injuries to seven people. In Kallambalam, a fire accident inside a well during cleaning operations injured three individuals. Separately, a fire mishap occurred at an under-construction ethanol plant in Nayagarh, injuring four people. The specific causes of both incidents are not detailed in the coverage.
